questions.question: What are your salary expectations?
questions.intention: Budget fit — and whether you know your market value.
questions.intentionPersian: تناسب با بودجه — و اینکه ارزش بازار خودت را می‌دانی یا نه.
questions.structure: Give a researched RANGE, anchor slightly high, mention flexibility on total package.
questions.example: Based on my research for this role and market, I'm looking at a range of X to Y. I'm flexible on the exact number depending on the total compensation — benefits, remote policy and growth matter to me too.
followUps: How did you arrive at that range?

questions.question: Could you share the salary range for this position?
questions.questionPersian: می‌توانید بازه حقوق این موقعیت را بگویید؟
questions.intention: YOUR question — asking it early and politely is professional, not rude.
questions.intentionPersian: سوال خودت — پرسیدن مودبانه و زودهنگام آن حرفه‌ای است، نه بی‌ادبی.

vocabulary.english: to make sure we're on the same page

questions.structure: Frame it as efficiency: making sure expectations are aligned before going deeper.
questions.example: Before we go further — could you share the budgeted range for this role? Just to make sure we're on the same page and respectful of each other's time.

questions.question: That's above our budget. Would you consider less?
questions.questionPersian: این بالاتر از بودجه ماست. کمتر را می‌پذیرید؟
questions.intention: Testing your floor — and how gracefully you negotiate.
questions.intentionPersian: آزمون کف قیمت تو — و ظرافت مذاکره‌ات.
questions.structure: Don't cave instantly; trade — extra leave, remote days, a salary review date, a signing bonus.
questions.example: I understand budgets are real. If the base can't move, could we make up the difference another way — say a signing bonus, an extra remote day, or a guaranteed salary review after six months?
followUps: Which of those matters most to you?

questions.question: What benefits are most important to you?
questions.questionPersian: کدام مزایا برای شما مهم‌تر است؟
questions.intention: Package design — and your priorities beyond cash.
questions.intentionPersian: طراحی بسته پیشنهادی — و اولویت‌های تو فراتر از پول.
questions.structure: Name your top 2-3 honestly and why — it signals what retains you.
questions.example: Flexibility first — remote days and flexible hours have a direct effect on my output. After that, a professional development budget; I invest a lot in learning and it's great when the company shares that.
followUps: Would you trade salary for more of those?

questions.question: We'd like to make you an offer. Do you accept?
questions.questionPersian: می‌خواهیم به شما پیشنهاد بدهیم. قبول می‌کنید؟
questions.intention: Pressure moment — asking for time is normal and professional.
questions.intentionPersian: لحظه فشار — فرصت خواستن کاملاً عادی و حرفه‌ای است.
questions.structure: Thank warmly + ask for it in writing + name a reply date (2-3 days). Never accept on the spot under pressure.
questions.example: Thank you — I'm genuinely excited about this. Could you send the full offer in writing? I'd like to look it over properly, and I'll get back to you by Thursday.
followUps: Is there anything in the offer you'd like to discuss now?

questions.question: Why do you deserve a higher salary than we offered?
questions.questionPersian: چرا مستحق حقوقی بالاتر از پیشنهاد ما هستید؟
questions.intention: Justify your counter with value, not need.
questions.intentionPersian: توجیه پیشنهاد متقابل با ارزش، نه با نیاز شخصی.
questions.structure: Market data + your specific extras (skills they need, ramp-up speed). Value language, never 'my rent went up'.
questions.example: Comparable roles in this market pay in the range I mentioned. Beyond that, I bring exactly the payment-systems experience this role needs — I'd be productive in weeks, not months, and that has real value.
followUps: What number would you accept today?

questions.question: What is your current salary?
questions.intention: Anchoring you low. You can politely redirect to expectations.
questions.intentionPersian: پایین نگه داشتن پیشنهاد. می‌توانی مودبانه بحث را به انتظاراتت برگردانی.
questions.structure: Deflect politely to the role's value and your researched range — firm, friendly, one sentence.
questions.example: I'd prefer to keep that confidential and focus on this role — based on its scope and the market, a fair range would be X to Y. Does that fit your budget?
followUps: Why don't you want to share it?

questions.question: When would you be able to start if we agreed today?
questions.questionPersian: اگر امروز توافق کنیم، کی می‌توانید شروع کنید؟
questions.intention: Logistics + eagerness check; protect your professional handover.
questions.intentionPersian: هماهنگی زمانی + سنجش اشتیاق؛ از تحویل حرفه‌ای کارها محافظت کن.
questions.structure: Notice period + buffer, stated as a firm, professional date.
questions.example: I'd give notice the same day. With my one-month notice period and a clean transition, I could commit to starting on the first of next month at the latest.
followUps: Could you negotiate a shorter notice period?

questions.question: We can't offer more salary, but is there anything else that would help?
questions.questionPersian: حقوق بیشتر نمی‌توانیم بدهیم، چیز دیگری کمک می‌کند؟
questions.intention: An opening — have your non-salary list ready.
questions.intentionPersian: یک فرصت — فهرست غیرحقوقی‌ات را آماده داشته باش.
questions.structure: Ask for 2 concrete things, ranked; get them in the written offer.
questions.example: Yes, two things would genuinely help: one extra remote day per week, and a yearly budget for a conference and courses. If we can include those in the written offer, the salary works for me.

questions.question: Are you interviewing with other companies?
questions.questionPersian: با شرکت‌های دیگر هم مصاحبه می‌کنید؟
questions.intention: Urgency and leverage check — honest but strategic.
questions.intentionPersian: سنجش فوریت و قدرت چانه‌زنی — صادق اما هوشمندانه.
questions.structure: Honest and brief; use it to align timelines, never as a fake threat.
questions.example: I'm in the process with two other companies at a similar stage. This role is honestly my first choice, so if your timeline allows a decision within two weeks, that works perfectly for me.
followUps: What would make us your clear first choice?
